origin.basis: Schwalbe is the brand of Ralf Bohle GmbH, Reichshof, Germany (legal notice).

manufacturing.basis: The Schwalbe product pages do not state where the tire is made.

availability.note: Schwalbe's European and North American sites give recommended retail prices and send buyers to retailers; mainland China availability not verified.

name: One 365 (tube type)
positioning: Schwalbe's all-season road tire with the ADDIX 4-Season compound, RaceGuard and a reflective strip.
caveats: Schwalbe claims grip at low temperatures but makes no specific wet-grip claim; no wet test recorded.
Needs an inner tube; the One 365 Tubeless is listed separately.

price_observations.conditions: Recommended retail price on the official product page on 2026-11-01; one tire; retailer prices vary.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.

reports.summary: A good winter tire with a comfortable ride at 80 psi.
Fitted easily with tubes; a bit squirmy in corners compared with the Durano it replaced, but much lighter.
Seems very tough, but rolls with a bit more resistance than the owner hoped.
Brilliant on a 1,000-mile loaded tour at about 55 psi: smooth, with no punctures and no obvious wear.
A comfortable all-rounder even in 25 mm, with good wet grip and enough speed through a very rainy spell.

checks.note: One of 6 written reviews is from before fitting
